name: 30260 · Morrow, GA
findings: ZIP 30260 (Morrow) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30260 (Morrow) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30260 (Morrow) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
